run_async_code: run asynchronous python code synchronously using asyncio with nest_asyncio fallback
read_sql_connectorx: read sql query results from a database connection uri into a polars DataFrame via connectorx
read_sql_adbc: read sql query results from a database connection uri into a polars DataFrame via ADBC driver
open_adbc_connection: open an ADBC database connection from a connection uri with automatic driver detection
is_adbc_snowflake_conn: test whether an ADBC connection is a Snowflake database connection
